links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of chatbot responses on head and neck reconstructive surgery
links.effect: ChatGPT4 FKGL mean 4.57 vs Claude2 6.05 (p < 0.001); ChatGPT4 requiring easy-fairly easy English in 93% of cases.
links.quote: Regarding readability, ChatGPT4 presented lower complexity than Claude2 (FKGL mean score 4.57 vs. 6.05, p < 0.001) requiring an easy-fairly easy English in 93% of cases.

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the quality, accuracy, and readability of responses generated by ChatGPT-4 and Claude 2 for head and neck cancer reconstructive surgery questions rated by surgeons.
